ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to the campus on Monday, April 25, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
